source: a curated calendar of public Chiang Mai events

events.title: Skate X Create
events.description: Spend an easy afternoon outdoors skating, drawing, and relaxing in the park. Open to skaters and creatives of all skill levels.

events.title: Sunday Sunset Walk & Connect at CMU
events.description: Take a gentle evening stroll around the CMU grounds to chat and unwind. Ideal for expats, travelers, and locals looking to meet new people.

events.title: All Day Gaming
events.description: Play a wide variety of tabletop titles, from casual picks to heavy strategy games. Perfect for both solo newcomers and seasoned players.

events.title: High-Intensity Circuit Training & Social Chat @ Decathlon – Central Festival
events.description: Boost your endurance with an energizing circuit workout, then hang out with the group. Open to all fitness levels, with exercise modifications offered.

events.title: Dune Days Tuesdays
events.description: Learn and play strategic deck-building and worker-placement games, centered around Dune Imperium. Great for board game enthusiasts of any experience level.

events.title: Intro Gamers night
events.description: Enjoy casual rounds of Catan across multiple editions, with rules taught on site. Ideal for beginner board gamers and social players.

events.title: Loose-Leaf Playground Writing X Poetry Club
events.description: Work on creative writing and poetry through light prompts, quiet focus time, and optional sharing. Suited to writers of all experience levels.

events.title: Strategy Thursdays
events.description: Tackle medium to heavy Euro-style board games focusing on pure strategy over luck. Perfect for fans of deep, analytical tabletop gameplay.

events.title: HAS YOUR LIFE ALREADY HAPPENED?
events.description: Explore mind-bending philosophical questions about time, fate, and the nature of existence. Suited to anyone curious about deep discussions.

events.title: Bring-a-Book Reading Club
events.description: Bring your current book and enjoy a relaxed reading session with fellow book lovers.

events.title: Founders Meetup by AI Fusion Labs
events.description: Connect with fellow entrepreneurs, tech innovators, and founders working with AI.

events.title: SWAPAHOLIC: Women's Clothing Swap
events.description: Refresh your wardrobe sustainably by exchanging pre-loved clothes with other women.

events.title: Youth Club — Screen-Free Sunday for Kids
events.description: Kids engage in creative, offline play and social activities during a screen-free Sunday session.

events.title: Be Fxcking Real: Authentic Connection Circle
events.description: Share genuine conversation and practice vulnerable, authentic communication in a supportive group circle.

events.title: Art Weekend: Terracotta & Water Color Workshops
events.description: Explore your creative side with hands-on terracotta crafting and watercolor painting workshops.

events.title: Sunday Dog Social @ Olio Homemade
events.description: Bring your pup for a friendly social meetup open to local dog owners and pet lovers.

events.title: Sunday Walking Street Market
events.description: Browse local handicrafts, street food, and vibrant stalls at this popular weekend walking street market.

events.title: Social Padel - All Level (Mexicano)
events.description: Play rotating padel matches in a fun Mexicano format, open to players of all skill levels.

events.title: Bollyx Dance with Live Dhol Beats
events.description: Dance to energetic Bollywood rhythms accompanied by live dhol drumming. Great for anyone wanting a fun, upbeat workout.

events.title: Improv Jam & Show
events.description: Watch spontaneous comedy scenes unfold or take the stage yourself in this playful improv session.

events.title: Chiang Mai Social & Singles Meetup
events.description: Mingle, chat, and make new connections in a relaxed social setting for local singles and expats.

events.title: Dance in Flow
events.description: Move freely to evocative music in a guided, expressive dance and movement practice.

events.title: Loving-Kindness Meditation & Buddhist Q&A

events.title: Stand-Up Comedy: Dana Alexander Live in Chiang Mai

events.title: Buddhist Study Group: Meditation, Teachings & Q&A

events.title: Enjoy Health, Live Well｜乐享健康·轻松养生 CHN event

events.title: AI for Women: Create, Learn & Connect - AI Goddesses Meetup Chiang Mai

events.title: MOVE STRONG – Bodyweight Strength & Quality Movement Session

events.title: Vibecoding for Women: Building Websites & Web Apps with Claude Code + AI

events.title: CNX Book Club Lite

events.title: MAI Thursday Board Game Meetup
